narrative.details:
Ah Chapter IV; the big finale!  And what an ending it was!

We are only missing three pages for this chapter.  We need pages 25, 26 and 27 to put Chapter IV back together.
narrative.objectives: Bring pages 25, 26, and 27 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter IV.
narrative.offerRewardText: Superb! We now have Chapter IV ready to go!
narrative.requestItemsText: We just need three pages to finish off Chapter IV, adventurer.  Do you have pages 25, 26 or 27 yet?
